@graph.name: muxaro.com Utility Suite
@graph.description: High-integrity, cloud-native media processing platform providing stream inspection, lossless audio extraction, audio/video remuxing, and multi-format conversion.
@graph.operatingSystem: All modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
@graph.browserRequirements: Requires JavaScript. HTML5 Media Source Extensions supported.

offers.description: Free tier includes 10 single media processing jobs and 1 playlist job per rolling 24-hour window.

DASH and HLS separate stream merging with millisecond sync validation
Full stream metadata probing via FFprobe architecture
Stream-copy remuxing without generational quality degradation
No unauthorized scraping, no CAPTCHA bypass, strict copyright compliance

@graph.name: Muxaro Lossless Audio Extractor
featureList: Support for MP4, WebM, MKV, and direct media URLs

@graph.name: Muxaro Audio-Video Stream Merger
